"''Yes, Governor, from the Oovo Four detention center.|A receptionist and Governor Arihnda Pryce|audio=OovoIV.flac|[[Thrawn (audiobook)|''Thrawn'' audiobook]]}} '''Oovo 4''', also known as '''Oovo Four''', was a high-security [[prison]] [[moon]] located near [[asteroid]]-strewn [[Realspace|space]]. The [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]] was designed for the task of guarding the moon, as a unique [[Starship|craft]] was needed for the job. In the [[Republic Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] at some point by [[32 BBY]], the famed [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] stole the ''Firespray-31'' ''[[Slave I]]'' from Oovo 4. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Oovo 4 was home to the [[Oovo Four detention center]]. After [[Juahir Madras]], a [[bodyguard]] [[instructor]] at the [[Yinchom Dojo]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], was [[Imperial espionage operation|arrested]] for convincing her trainees to attack and occasionally [[Death|murder]] of several [[senator]]s in the [[Imperial Senate]] they were tasked with protecting, she was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] at the detention center. While there, Madras sent at least twenty messages to her friend [[Arihnda Pryce]], [[Governor of the Lothal sector|governor]] of the planet [[Lothal]]. Sometime around [[9 ABY]], Oovo 4 was operated by the [[New Republic]]. The [[Zabrak]] [[Thene Kross]] was listed as being sentenced to thirty [[Standard year|years]] on Oovo 4 for grand theft starship and resisting arrest. ==Description== Located near [[asteroid]]-strewn [[Realspace|space]],{{BuildXWingCite|11|Starfighter Aces}} Oovo 4,''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' also referred to as Oovo Four, was a high-security [[prison]] [[moon]] and was guarded by [[Kuat Systems Engineering]]'s''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]]. It was also the location of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Oovo Four detention center|detention center]]. ==History== At some point by [[32 BBY]],[[Age of Republic - Jango Fett 1|''Age of Republic - Jango Fett'' 1]] shows ''[[Slave I]]'' in [[Jango Fett]]'s possession when he was recruited by [[Dooku]] to serve as the [[Clone template|genetic template]] of the [[clone trooper]]s. [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] also establishes that Jango Fett was recruited before the birth of [[Boba Fett]], who was ten [[Standard year|years]] old when the former [[Death|died]], according to ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates Jango Fett's death to [[22 BBY]], he must have acquired the [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft|starship]] by [[32 BBY]]. the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] stole a Firespray-31 from Oovo 4 and named it ''[[Slave I]]''.[[Star Wars: Star Pilot (2015)|''Star Wars: Star Pilot'']] Later, during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the Galactic Empire, the moon became home to the [[Oovo Four detention center]], and after [[bodyguard]] [[instructor]] [[Juahir Madras]] was [[Imperial espionage operation|arrested]] for convincing her trainees to both assault and [[Death|murder]] [[Imperial Senate|Imperial Senators]] they were tasked with protecting, she was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] at the detention center. While imprisoned, Madras sent at least twenty messages to her friend [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] of the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. In [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|14}} the [[New Republic]] controlled Oovo 4. The [[Zabrak]] [[Thene Kross]] was listed as being sentenced to thirty [[Standard year|years]] on the moon for theft of [[starship]]s and resisting arrest. ==Behind the scenes== Oovo 4 was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[Star Wars: Star Pilot (2015)|''Star Wars: Star Pilot'']], a [[2015]] children's book written by [[Laura Buller]]. The moon was later identified in the 2015 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' It was alternatively referred to as Oovo Four in the [[2017]] novel [[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']], authored by [[Timothy Zahn]]. Oovo 4 was originally introduced in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity via [[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']], a [[1999]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]].[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']] ==Appearances== *[[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']] {{Ab|Thrawn (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} {{1stID|Oovo Four}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}} {{C|Mentioned on screen}} ==Sources== *{{BuildFalconCite|28|Starship Fact File}} {{1stm}} *[[Star Wars: Star Pilot (2015)|''Star Wars: Star Pilot'']] {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'' {{1stID|Oovo 4}} *{{BuildFalconCite|64|Guide to the Galaxy}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' *{{BuildXWingCite|11|Starfighter Aces}} *{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|8|Starships and Vehicles}} *''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett Collector's Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Oovo IV |ka=უვო-4 }} [[Category:Galactic Empire moons]] [[Category:Moons in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Moons in the Slice]] [[Category:New Republic moons]] [[Category:Oovo system locations]] [[Category:Prison moons]]
